rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis specifies the same intervention (in situ heating from 298 K to 973 K at 1 K/s under vacuum, analyzed by aberration-corrected STEM and atomistic MD simulations) applied to the same material (equiatomic AuCoCuNiPt HENA nanoparticles synthesized via PLD at 873 K on a silicon nitride membrane). This matches the paper's intervention exactly.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis lists the same vacuum environment, heating steps (473, 673, 773, 873, 973 K), and analysis time limit (45 min per step) as the paper's conditions.
